title: Explicit-port URL parsers do not bound the copied hostname
description:
indigo_uni_io.c:1584-1588 and indigo_io.c:367-370: explicit-port URL parsing copies colon-host bytes to host_name[INDIGO_NAME_SIZE] and writes a terminator at the same unbounded index. Public helpers accept longer URLs; drivers pass device URL property strings into this path. A malformed/overlong hostname corrupts stack before any network connection. Next: Reject host segments >= sizeof(host_name) before copying and validate URL/port syntax. Cover both helpers at limit-1/limit/over-limit. No network is needed to exercise parsing rejection.
